Workspace.RefreshBaselineGameUpdateConfi:
The game appears to have replaced initial.pak. This saves the current file as the new read-only baseline. Use this only when the pak is the new unmodified vanilla file.

Your saved tuning profile is kept so you can reapply afterwards. Continue?

The working pak differs from the baseline. Replace the baseline with the current file?

Only continue if this is an unmodified vanilla initial.pak (for example after a game update).
